description:
Python and Kubernetes Software Engineer - Data, AI/ML & Analytics

4 months ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring Python and Kubernetes Specialist Engineers focused on Data, AI/ML and Analytics Solutions to join our teams building open source solutions for public cloud and private infrastructure.
As a software engineer on the team, you'll collaborate on an end-to-end data analytics and mlops solution composed of popular, open-source, machine learning tools, such as Kubeflow, MLFlow, DVC, and Feast. You may also work on workflow, ETL, data governance and visualization tools like Apache SuperSet, dbt, and Temporal, or data warehouse solutions such as Apache Trino, or ClickHouse. Your team will own a solution from the analytics and machine learning space, and integrate with the solutions from other teams to build the world's best end-to-end data platform. These solutions may be run on servers or on the cloud, on machines or on Kubernetes, on developer desktops, or as web services.
We serve the needs of individuals and community members as much as the needs of our Global 2000 and Fortune 500 customers; we make our primary work available free of charge and our Pro subscriptions are also available to individuals for personal use at no cost. Our goal is to enable more people to enjoy the benefits of open source, regardless of their circumstances.
Location: This initiative spans many teams that are home-based and in multiple time zones. We believe in distributed collaboration but we also try to ensure that colleagues have company during their work hourse! Successful candidates will join a team where most members and your manager are broadly in the same time zone so that you have the benefits of constant collaboration and discussion.
What your day will look like

  • Develop your understanding of the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, and storage, to the application layer
  • Design, build and maintain solutions that will be deployed on public and private clouds and local workstations
  • Master distributed systems concepts such as observability, identity, tracing
  • Work with both Kubernetes and machine-oriented open source applications
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team of engineers, designers and product managers
  • Debug issues and interact in public with upstream and Ubuntu communities
  • Generate and discuss ideas, and collaborate on finding good solutions
What we are looking for in you
  • Professional or academic software delivery using Python
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Additional Skills That Would Be Nice To Have

The following skills may be helpful to you in the role, but we don't expect everyone to bring all of them.
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning libraries, or tools.
  • Proven track record of building highly automated machine learning solutions for the cloud.
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • Experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Working knowledge of cloud computing
  • Passionate about software quality and testing
  • Experience working on an open source project
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme

  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

We design and maintain specialist Python tools to support the developer build and publication process. The team takes responsibility for tooling that builds snaps, charms and more recently, rocks.

Snapcraft allows developers to deliver app updates to millions of Linux systems automatically, eliminating the long tail of supported releases and complex install instructions. Snapcraft enables thousands of applications from over a thousand developers, including well-recognised names like Spotify, Slack, and Microsoft.

Likewise, Charmcraft enables collaboration between charmed operator developers, and publication on Charmhub, home of the Charmed Operator Collection. And Rockcraft provides the means for container developers to build production-grade Ubuntu-based container images, regardless of their experience as a software developer. These container images are called Rocks and can be found in various popular container registries, like Docker Hub, offering an opinionated and consistent design that focus on security while providing an homogeneous user experience across all rocks.

Overall objective of the role is to be a visible and engaged champion of Seadrill’s Task Process (PIMED – Plan, Identify, Manage, Execute & Debrief) to drive safe, efficient and reliable operations.   • Monitor rig emergency response plans (ERPs) to ensure they are known and drilled at rig and area level.
  • Maintain CIM for the IMT and use it correctly as delegated.

  • Attend client HSEQ forums and provide lessons learned feedback.
  • Ensure HSE bridging documents are in place and current.
  • Engage with HSE teams of customers and customer service providers.
  • Produce and communicate HSEQ alerts following incident investigations and IRB to share lessons learned.
  • Support HSE performance data‑led review of red rig recovery plans and implement red rig recovery plans.
  • Ensure all events are reported correctly in Synergi.
  • Act as lead investigator in area HSE investigations.
  • Conduct regular rig visits to support rig management team and OHSEAs.
  • Monitor RVs and ODVs by OHSEAs to ensure quality verifications and close findings in a timely manner.
  • Maintain detailed knowledge of HSE regulatory requirements in the area of operations.
  • Participate in HSE regulatory audits and close‑out meetings.
  • Perform safety stewardship in line with Seadrill’s safety culture.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in offshore HSE or 7 years’ experience in onshore HSE outside drilling.
  • Strong analytical skills and confident communication.
  • Team player with a commitment to core HSE processes.
  • Proficient in incident investigation and root‑cause identification.
  • Proficiency in MS Office suite (PowerPoint, Word, Excel).
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken); other languages a plus.
  • Current knowledge of industry initiatives impacting Seadrill operations (e.g., IADC, DROPS, HPOG).
  • Understanding of applicable HSE regulatory requirements and familiarity with flag and coastal state requirements (e.g., ISM, IMO).
  • Hold NEBOSH Diploma in OH&S or equivalent HSE certification.
  • Completion of Seadrill Training Matrix and competence matrices.
  • Participation in audit team with company auditor on HSE compliance audit.
  • Active personal development plan and formal identification on succession plan.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • BOSIET, offshore survival training and other required training.
  • Higher education qualification in HSE/engineering or risk management discipline preferred.

Seadrill offers a competitive package built around an attractive base salary and a range of benefits tailored to your location. Join Seadrill. Own the opportunity.

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

The Host Broadcast Production Manager will report jointly to the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast in Brazil and the Zurich-based Senior Host Broadcast Production Lead. The role is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all broadcast-related infrastructure and overlay, ensuring successful delivery of the tournament.

This includes close collaboration with all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives, stadium authorities, and relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include the Final Draw, two Play-off Tournaments, and the main tournament period (June–July 2027).

The position will require periods of extended travel and operational hours, attendance at site inspections. The selected candidate will also be expected to escalate risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

Key responsibilities

  • Ensuring the compliance of the broadcast areas at the 8 stadiums within Brazil, in accordance with FIFA requirements.
  • Liaising closely with Host Cities, Stadiums, and FIFA27 Local Entity counterparts on the on-going development of broadcast facilities including access and zoning through all phases of the project.
  • Collaborating with the FIFA27 Local Entity Technical Services and Containment Managers, Overlay Teams, and Stadium Authorities in the planning and preparation for all host broadcast and unilateral broadcast-related overlay, including legacy infrastructure at the venues (camera platforms, broadcast cable pathways, studios and presentation positions, interview areas, broadcast commentary positions, and all installations within the Broadcast Compound).
  • Supervising, in coordination with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals/departures of technical facilities at the Broadcast Compound.
  • Ensuring the necessary overlay infrastructure is provided on schedule ahead of the arrival on-site of the host broadcaster.
  • Working closely with overall venue management teams for planning, development, and delivery.
  • Leading weekly, fortnightly, and monthly reporting documentation and meetings on tournament planning progress, managing and resolving risks and issues for venues within the assigned country, and escalating urgent issues to the Head of Broadcast and Project Lead in a timely manner.
  • Working across multiple time zones to be the main point of contact and support for the Project Lead and Host Broadcast Production department based in Zurich, and the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast based in Rio de Janeiro, coordinating with Media Partners and Relations and Content Production Teams to ensure seamless host broadcast and unilateral broadcast planning and operations at the venues.
  • Supervising, in close collaboration with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals and departures to the Broadcast Compound of all technical facilities and other deliveries.
  • Serving as main point of contact for Project Lead and Host Broadcaster, providing liaison and support for areas such as match day broadcast accreditation and access issues, radio frequencies, broadcast security, broadcast cleaning and schedule control, unilateral broadcasters’ filming requests, stadium visits, and issue resolutions.
  • Pre-planning, on-site support and delivery for the Play-off Final tournaments, draw event and any other such events including internal workshops and training sessions.

Your profile

Python Software Engineer - Ubuntu Hardware Certification Team

3 months ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is hiring a Python Software Engineer to join the Certification team, who make the tools which enable us to know that a desktop, laptop, server or IoT device is working properly. We work at the interface of hardware and software, so the ideal candidate is a Python developer familiar with hardware.
The Certification team develops the tools needed to certify hardware as working with Ubuntu Core as well as Ubuntu Desktop and Server: design hardware which can be used to probe devices independently, and frameworks for software tests that check every aspect of Ubuntu on that hardware.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to have a meaningful impact for adoption of Linux across multiple device categories and industries. Canonical offers a fun, fast-paced team environment and a career full of learning and development opportunities. This team is centered in EMEA time zones, and works with colleagues on related teams in both the Americas and APAC.
We work together with silicon companies, OEMs, ODMs and teams within Canonical to ensure a smooth, secure out of the box Ubuntu experience, with success in this role leading to a great Ubuntu experience being offered on more and more devices.
Role description
We are looking for a self-motivated software engineer with experience developing in Python, to work on test automation tools or Linux based embedded hardware. This role offers an exciting opportunity to push the industry forward by enabling entirely new Linux based hardware testing capabilities, scaling up hardware certification efforts and allowing for deeper test coverage.
The role involves the development and maintenance of Canonical's open source certification tools, supporting the creation of hardware solutions for test automation, and automating our existing processes. We seek out continuous process and tooling improvements as part of expanding the certification test suites, ultimately to improve the quality of Linux experience felt by millions of Linux end users.
Key responsibilities

  • Maintain and develop new features to our Python based test automation tools like Checkbox, used by both in-house teams and industry partners.
  • Invent new ways to enable remote, automated testing.
  • Help build the software counterpart to in-house designed testing hardware to help test device enablement (graphics, hotplug, bluetooth, etc).
  • Write functional and performance tests to support hardware enablement and to protect from regressions.
  • Participate in meetings involving international travel 2-3 times per year.
Required Skills And Experience
  • Knowledge of Python programming language.
  • Quality oriented, pragmatic approach to software design and implementation.
  • Interest in test automation methodologies.
  • Previous experience working with Ubuntu or other Linux distributions.
  • Ability to be productive in a globally distributed team.
Desired Skills And Experience
  • Passion for tinkering: you are a maker.
  • Experience working in an agile environment.
  • Hardware testing experience, for example in the IoT space.
  • Familiarity with the C programming language.
What is Canonical?
Canonical is a growing international software company that works with the open-source community to deliver Ubuntu, "the world's best free software platform". Our services help businesses worldwide to reduce costs, improve efficiency and enhance security with Ubuntu.
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
O Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho deve garantir a integridade física e a saúde dos colaboradores próprios e terceiros, a conformidade legal e a prevenção de acidentes nas operações de transportes e logística da DeLuna, promovendo uma cultura de segurança alinhada aos valores e metas ESG da empresa.

Requisitos

  • Curso Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho concluído. Registro/credenciamento profissional.
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos em operações de logística, armazenagem e transportes.
  • Conhecimentos técnicos:
    • NRs aplicáveis (NR-01, 04, 05, 06, 07, 10, 11, 12, 17, 20, 23, 26, 33, 35).
    • PGR, inventário de riscos, APR, permissões de trabalho, investigação de acidentes.
    • Segurança em armazéns, docas, empilhadeiras, amarração e movimentação de cargas.
    • Noções de saúde ocupacional e eSocial.
    • Combate a incêndio e brigada; plano de emergência e simulados.
    • Ergonomia aplicada a logística e operações frigorificadas.
  • Ferramentas:
    • Pacote Office/Google e ferramentas de checklists/auditorias digitais.
    • Sistemas de gestão de SST/SESMT e eSocial.
  • Habilitações/cursos desejáveis:
    • Instrutor NR-35/NR-33, brigada de incêndio, direção defensiva.
    • Noções de ISO 45001 e ISO 14001; primeiros socorros.
    • CNH B; disponibilidade para viagens.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Foco em segurança e cuidado ativo; presença em campo.
  • Comunicação clara e didática com públicos diversos.
  • Influência e negociação para gerenciamento de mudanças.
  • Organização, senso de urgência e disciplina na gestão de planos de ação.
  • Colaboração e postura consultiva com atendimento personalizado, alinhada aos valores DeLuna.
  • Integridade, confidencialidade e respeito às pessoas.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência em operações e-commerce/last mile.
  • Experiência com gestão de transportadores terceiros e auditorias de clientes.
  • Participação em projetos de certificação e programs de cultura de segurança.

Responsabilidades e Atividades

1) Governança SST e Compliance

  • Atuar como integrante do SESMT conforme dimensionamento da NR-04.
  • Implementar e manter o PGR com inventário de riscos e plano de ação; apoiar as avaliações de exposição conforme NRs vigentes.
  • Apoiar a CIPA no dimensionamento, capacitação e cronograma anual; organizar SIPAT.
  • Gerir EPI/ EPC: especificação, distribuição, rastreabilidade, controle de vida útil e treinamentos.
  • Assegurarconformidade com NRs aplicáveis às operações DeLuna.
  • Acompanhar legislação aplicável ao transporte e logística e requisitos de clientes.

2) Operações de CDs, XPts e Transit Points

  • Realizar inspeções de rotina e emitir relatórios com planos de ação.
  • Validar layout seguro, sinalização, rotas de pedestres/empilhadeiras, proteção de estruturas, housekeeping.
  • Conduzir análises ergonômicas pontuais e propor melhorias.
  • Inspecionar sistemas de combate a incêndio e suportar brigada de incêndio;
  • Verificar condições de câmaras frias e EPIs térmicos em operações frigorificadas.

3) Transporte Rodoviário (FM/MM/LM, LH)

  • Apoiar programas de direção defensiva, análise de rotas críticas, gestão de fadiga e pausas.
  • Realizar inspeções de frota focadas em segurança.
  • Verificar documentação e treinamentos obrigatórios de motoristas e ajudantes conforme a legislação aplicável.
  • Conduzir DDS e blitz de segurança em pátios e pontos de apoio.
  • Investigar sinistros rodoviários e quase-acidentes, propondo ações corretivas e lições aprendidas.

4) Saúde Ocupacional e eSocial

  • Interface com PCMSO e Médico do Trabalho: exames admissionais, periódicos, retorno ao trabalho e mudança de função.
  • Apoiar os eventos do eSocial em conjunto com RH/DP e colaboradores.
  • Apoiar a elaboração de laudos e avaliações por profissionais legalmente habilitados, providenciando dados e acompanhando planos de ação.

5) Treinamentos, Cultura e Comunicação

  • Planejar, ministrar e/ou coordenar treinamentos obrigatórios e específicos.
  • Gerenciar a matriz de capacitação, controles de validade e reciclagens; garantir 100% de aderência.
  • Conduzir campanhas e comunicações de segurança, reforçando os valores e a cultura DeLuna.

6) Emergências e Preparação/Resposta

  • Manter plano de emergência atualizado: cenários em armazéns, câmaras frias, incêndio, vazamento de combustíveis, sinistros rodoviários.
  • Realizar simulados periódicos com brigada e times operacionais; alinhar com corpo de bombeiros e contratadas.
  • Garantir kits de emergência, fichas de segurança e contatos úteis disponíveis e atualizados.

7) Gestão de Terceiros e Fornecedores

  • Qualificar, auditar e acompanhar prestadores sob critérios de SST; verificar documentos, treinamentos e indicadores.
  • Incluir requisitos de SST em contratos e SLAs em parceria com Suprimentos e Jurídico.
  • Acompanhar execução de manutenção predial e de equipamentos por terceiros com Permissão de Trabalho quando aplicável.

8) ESG e Melhoria Contínua

  • Contribuir para metas ESG.
  • Apoiar auditorias internas/externas e requisitos de clientes;
  • Liderar investigação de incidentes com metodologia estruturada e garantir a eficácia das ações.

Join to apply for the Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction role at Maersk Supply Service

Join to apply for the Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction role at Maersk Supply Service

At Maersk Supply Service, we believe that crewing is more than logistics—it’s about people. We’re looking for a Crew Analyst who shares our commitment to openness, collaboration, respect and to build a trustful relationship with all stakeholders, especially our offshore colleagues. If you’re someone who values transparent communication and wants to make a meaningful impact on the lives of our offshore colleagues, we’d love to hear from you.

Who are we?

At Maersk Supply Service (MSS), we’re more than a marine solutions provider—we’re a team of people who genuinely care about doing things right. Based in Rio de Janeiro, you’ll be welcomed into a close-knit HR & Crewing team that thrives on collaboration, open dialogue, and mutual respect. You’ll work alongside colleagues from across the organisation, each bringing their own expertise to help us navigate the complexities of the energy sector with integrity, safety, and purpose.

We enjoy what we do! We have a flexible and energized work environment. Here, ideas are not just heard—they’re valued. We celebrate our diverse backgrounds and see them as a true source of strength. We work close together, humbling listening and learning from each other, and overcoming challenges together, “we” should come before “I”. Every day, we strive to create a supportive space where your voice matters and your contributions lead to real change. This role is a unique blend of operational excellence and human connection.

As a company, we are owned by A.P. Moller Holding, operating independently with the trust and empowerment to do what is right for us, while proudly bearing the Maersk name and values.

What You Will Be Doing

The crewing department includes several HR subsystems, and as a Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction – you’ll play a key role in shaping the future of our MSS operations.

You’ll drive alignment on talent attraction strategies and process along with the Crew Manager, will execute the talent attraction process, and build a sustainable pool of skilled professionals by leading our cadet programme—supporting the growth and development of new seafarers and helping them thrive in their maritime careers.

Who You Are

First and foremost, you are passionate about the maritime industry, talent attraction and enjoy building up trusted relationships, and you recognize the game-changing potential by working in crewing and the positive effect that you can bring to people’s life. In addition, we hope you can say yes to the following:

  • Proficiency in verbal and written English and Portuguese.
  • Bachelor’s degree in psychology, Administration or related areas.
  • MBA in Human Resource is preferable for this position.
  • 3 years of previous experience in similar roles. Previous roles in the Maritime industry would be an advantage.
  • Has a strategic mindset and understands how talent drives business success.
  • Build strong networks and knows how to attract top talent through authentic engagement.
  • Communicates with clarity and impact—whether crafting employer branding or engaging with candidates.
  • Makes quality decisions quickly and confidently, even in fast-paced environments.
  • Champions diversity and inclusion, valuing different perspectives and backgrounds.
  • Is customer-focused, always thinking about the candidate experience.
  • Thrives on collaboration, influencing stakeholders and aligning hiring needs across teams.
  • Operational Excellence: Strong attention to detail in managing crew data, cost control, and vessel planning, ensuring smooth and compliant operations.
  • Process Improvement & Quality Focus: Proactive in identifying opportunities to enhance procedures and energise the team through continuous improvement.

How to Apply

If you can imagine yourself in this role, we look very much forward to hearing from you. Please apply through our website no later than 12 September 2025. We will review and interview on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

title: Senior Data Architect – Data & AI
description:
Company Overview

Blue Orange Digital is a cloud-based data transformation and predictive analytics development firm with offices in NYC and Washington, DC. From startups to Fortune 500s, we help companies make sense of their business challenges by applying modern data analytics techniques, visualizations, and AI/ML. Founded by engineers, we love passionate technologists and data analysts. Our startup DNA means everyone on the team makes a direct contribution to the growth of the company.

Note: Please submit your resume in English, as all application materials must be in English for review and consideration.

Overview

We are seeking a Databricks Data Architect who can own Lakehouse design and governance and represent that vision in front of clients. You’ll spend most of your time embedded with delivery squads—modeling data, tuning clusters, and enforcing standards—but you’ll also step into discovery workshops, help scope solutions, and support pre-sales conversations when deep architectural insight is needed.

Responsibilities

  • Client Engagement & Solution Development
    • Act as the primary technical liaison during key engagements—translating business goals into architecture that both sides understand.
    • Lead discovery workshops and roadmap sessions to surface requirements, constraints, and success metrics, then map them to scalable Databricks patterns.
    • Partner with account & sales teams to shape estimates, reference architectures, and bill-of-materials for proposals and SOWs.
    • Provide architecture-level answers for RFPs/RFIs and join pitch calls when deep Databricks credibility is essential.
    • Mentor client technical leads during early project phases to ensure knowledge transfer and long-term success.
  • Lakehouse Architecture & Design
    • Design logical/physical models, storage layers, and streaming/CDC patterns with Delta Lake and Unity Catalog.
    • Architect multi-cloud Databricks solutions (AWS, Azure, GCP) covering ETL/ELT, structured streaming, and governance zones.
  • Governance & Security
    • Define catalog/permission models, retention policies, and lineage artifacts to meet HIPAA, SOC 2, GDPR, and similar frameworks.
    • Implement row-/column-level security, tokenization, and end-to-end audit logging.
  • Performance & Cost Optimization
    • Tune cluster sizing, Photon/SQL Warehouse configs, Z-Ordering, and auto-compaction to hit SLA and cost targets.
    • Instrument dashboards for query latency, job runtimes, and spend.
    • Lead design reviews, pair with engineers on PySpark/Scala, and sign off on pull requests before production.
    • Publish best-practice templates, Terraform workspace bootstraps, and CI/CD guidelines.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Work closely with Platform Ops, Security, Analytics, and Product teams to translate requirements into production-ready data solutions.
    • Host lunch-and-learns and brown-bag demos to level-up Databricks skill sets across Blue Orange.

Requirements

  • 5–7 years building cloud data platforms; 3+ years hands-on with Databricks.
  • Deep expertise in Delta Lake ACID, Unity Catalog, and Spark performance tuning.
  • Proven experience architecting Lakehouse or Cloud DW solutions on two or more major clouds.
  • Strong SQL + PySpark/Scala; working knowledge of dbt, Airflow, or similar orchestrators.
  • Databricks Data Engineer Professional certification (or ability to earn in 90 days).
  • Excellent communication skills for client workshops, documentation, and mentoring.
  • Ability to engage with and communicate effectively with clients at all levels, developing technical solutions that solve their challenges and/or advance their interests.
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into understandable terms; adept at engaging and influencing senior management and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, particularly adept at conveying complex technical concepts effectively to non-technical audiences.
  • Self-directed and motivated with a results-driven approach, capable of achieving deliveries and outcomes independently with limited external direction.
  • Eager to learn and adapt in a rapidly evolving tech landscape.
  • Ability and willingness to travel as required to meet clients and attend industry events.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience as a Databricks Champion within your organization.
  • Experience migrating legacy Hadoop/Snowflake/Redshift to Lakehouse.
  • Familiarity with MLflow, Feature Store, and Databricks Model Serving.
  • DataOps/CI-CD for notebooks and IaC (Terraform, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).
  • Domain depth in one of our focus verticals (FinTech, Sports Analytics, Manufacturing, etc.).
  • Experience with transactional data systems and stacks, such as Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, SQL Server, Postgres, MongoDB, as well as microservices, message queues, actor-models, event-driven architectures, etc.
  • Experience consulting in Retail/CPG; Manufacturing; Travel & Hospitality.
  • Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, JD Edwards, Oracle, Sage, Workday, etc.
  • Engineering certifications in Databricks (beyond pro), Azure, AWS, GCP, Snowflake, and related tools.
  • Experience serving as a consultative liaison between clients and technical teams. Able to engage with senior-level stakeholders to understand their business challenges and articulate clear, compelling technical solutions aligned with their strategic goals.
  • Self-starter with proven abilities leading complex client engagement deliveries, often with ambiguity and little direction.
  • Master’s, MBA, or other advanced degree a plus.

Salary: USD$7,524 - $10,032.00 (monthly salary range DOE)

General information

OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect M/F

As an Independent Power Producer,Voltalia operates in over 20 countries, developing, building, and maintainingrenewable energy projects and services across five key technologies: solar,wind, hydro, biomass, and storage. Backed by the AFM Group, a globallyrecognized, family-owned investment group, we benefit from long-term stabilityand a shared commitment to sustainable growth.

By the end of 2024, our operational and under-construction capacity reached 3.3 gigawatts—a 14% increase since 2023. With 1,500 employees worldwide, we thrive in a fast-moving environment driven by adaptability, innovation, and collaboration.

In our company, your work directly contributes to a more sustainable world. Whether you're driving projects forward, optimizing operations, or leading strategic initiatives, you're contributing to our mission to improve the global environment and foster local development.

At Voltalia, we welcome individuals from all backgrounds, whatever your race, ethnicity, gender, nationality, age, disability, sexual orientation, and experience. In our company, diversity drives innovation and contributes to a workplace where everyone can thrive.

Ready to make an impact? Bring your energy—let’s power a sustainable future together!

YOUR MISSIONS

The OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect is responsible for designing and implementing the technical components of the organization's cybersecurity strategy. This role involves creating secure systems and network architectures, selecting and configuring security technologies, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure the organization's digital assets are adequately protected.

  • Develop and implement OT cybersecurity architectures tailored for renewable energy production and operations.
  • Design secure and scalable network architectures for OT environments, including SCADA, ICS, and IoT systems.
  • Ensure OT security strategies align seamlessly with corporate IT and cybersecurity policies, while also adhering to industry standards, including IEC 62443 and ISO 27001.
  • Implement and supervise cybersecurity tools, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and vulnerability scanners, in OT environments.
  • Monitor and respond to OT security incidents, collaborating with incident response teams.
  • Collaborate with GRC team to address regulatory requirements.
  • Work closely with engineering, operations, and IT teams to integrate security into the lifecycle of OT assets.
  • Provide cybersecurity training and awareness programs for staff working with OT systems.
  • Engage with external vendors and partners to ensure secure deployment of third-party OT solutions.
  • Stay updated on emerging cybersecurity threats, trends, and technologies relevant to OT environments.
  • Develop and implement strategies for continuous improvement of OT cybersecurity posture.
  • Lead pilot projects and proof-of-concept initiatives for new cybersecurity technologies.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCES

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in cybersecurity, with at least 2 years focusing on OT environments (e.g., SCADA, ICS).
  • Deep knowledge of OT systems and protocols, including Modbus, DNP3, OPC, and MQTT.
  • Proficiency with cybersecurity frameworks like IEC 62443, NIST CSF, and MITRE ATT&CK for ICS.
  • Familiarity with firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and endpoint protection in OT environments.
  • Strong understanding of networking principles (e.g., VLANs, VPNs, routing).
  • Experience in renewable energy or other critical infrastructure industries is a plus.
  • CISSP, GICSP, CISM, or equivalent certifications preferred.
  • Proficiency both in Portuguese and English.
  • Availiability for international travels.

KEY SKILLS

  • Strategic Vision-
  • Problem-Solving and organizational skills.
  • Strong ability to articulate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Proficiency in building relationships with internal and external partners to drive cybersecurity initiatives.
  • Resilient
  • Strong attention to detail to ensure precision in designing, implementing, and auditing cybersecurity measures.
  • Flexibility to respond to evolving cybersecurity threats and technological advancements.

As a software engineer on the team, you'll collaborate on end-to-end data analytics and MLOps solutions composed of popular, open-source, machine learning tools, such as Kubeflow, MLFlow, DVC, and Feast. description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably. Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Purpose

  • As a Change Management Business Partner, your role is to provide expert advisory services and support to a portfolio of change initiatives across the organization to ensure delivery of expected business outcomes through adoption and usage. You will partner with project teams, leaders, and stakeholders to embed change management best practices, build change capability, and drive adoption of change initiatives. By leveraging your expertise and insights, you will enable the successful execution of change projects and contribute to building a change-ready culture.

Responsibilities

  • Providing strategic guidance and advice to project teams and stakeholders on change management principles, methodologies, and tools to support the successful delivery of change initiatives

  • Guiding and coaching the project team to fulfill their roles with the appropriate behaviors and actions to support the change plan
  • Delivering training programs, workshops, and materials to build change management capabilities among project teams, leaders, and employees
  • Capturing and sharing lessons learned, best practices, and success stories from change initiatives to inform future projects and enhance organizational change management capability
  • Continuously assessing and refining change management approaches and tools to ensure relevance and effectiveness in supporting change efforts

Education

  • Master degree preferred in Business Administration, Organizational Psychology, Change Management, or related field

Experience

  • 3-5 years of experience in providing change management advisory services in a complex organizational environment.

Functional Competencies

  • Stakeholder mapping
  • Training, facilitation services delivery
  • Community management
  • Analytics and reporting
  • Business Partnering
  • Business Acumen
  • Internal project management / Planning
  • Change Management

Fundados em 1996, somos líderes na fabricação e na distribuição de materiais e medicamentos para o segmento da saúde, com produtos e soluções para todo o Brasil. Com o propósito de cuidar de cada vida, somos a única empresa do Brasil que atua de forma completa no mercado da saúde. Essa atuação reforça nosso compromisso em oferecer soluções confiáveis, ágeis e inovadoras ao setor – incluindo fabricação, distribuição, gestão de estoque, transporte e soluções personalizadas aos hospitais, clínicas, laboratórios, farmácias, atacados, indústrias farmacêuticas e aos pacientes finais. Buscamos encontrar e viabilizar as inovações que definirão como cuidar das pessoas do amanhã.

  • Empresas que realizam a distribuição do canal de laboratórios e clínicas: Tecnocold e Prevena.

  • No atendimento à pessoa física possuímos: Mafra Especialidades e Humânia.

Promovemos e disseminamos a Diversidade e Inclusão em todo ecossistema Viveo, conscientizando nossos(as) colaboradores(as) com ações no Pilar LGBTQIA+ (SerQuemSou), Pilar Raça (NaRaça), Pilar Gênero (emPoderAEla) e Pilar Pessoa com Deficiência (SuperAção).

Por isso, buscamos para os nossos times pessoas que sejam protagonistas em transformação de vidas, independente de sexo, raça, religião, nacionalidade, idade, deficiência ou orientação sexual.

Faça parte do maior ecossistema de saúde do Brasil!

Vem com a gente cuidar de cada vida e unir-se conosco na responsabilidade de criar futuros mais saudáveis!

description:
Overview

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Diagnosticar e acompanhar o portador de transtorno mental, articular os recursos da rede para oferecer a melhor combinação de estratégias de cuidado, de maneira individualizada, em cada fase do tratamento e apoiar as equipes e profissionais, realizando atividades de educação permanente e utilizando a ferramenta do apoio matricial.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina
  • Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista em Psiquiatria
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada como Médico em Psiquiatria

Informações adicionais

  • Hospital Municipal Pedro II/ CER Santa Cruz - RJ
  • Carga horária: 12h ou 24h semanais
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

description:
Job Description

Fugro’s innovation teams are responsible for carrying out developments serving both internal users and Fugro clients. With Innovation centers in Canada, Brazil, USA, and other key locations around the world; you will be joining a global innovation group with a tradition of developing best‑of‑class applications in the Geo‑data space. Our engineers are experts in domains such as spatial data, cloud computing, deep learning, and process automation.

As a Senior Software Engineer at Fugro, you will be responsible for the development, maintenance and support of innovation software products, ensuring quality, timelines and cost‑effectiveness of innovation projects are achieved. Your work will comply with company standards and you will be actively contributing to the continuous improvement of the engineering process, by delivering safe and good‑quality software increments.

What You Will Do

  • Develop and maintain high‑quality software during their lifecycle.
  • Implement software projects using C# and Angular, or similar technologies.
  • Ensure regular communication with other developers and teams involved in the development process.
  • Deliver and recommend architectural solutions to the product.
  • Implement, test, and perform system and functionality corrections (bug fixes).
  • Act as a member throughout the delivery process of agile methodologies using Scrum.
  • Build and maintain efficient and reliable / stable source codes.
  • Collaborate with team members at all stages, from prototype, production and implementation / progress throughout the project.
  • Solve complex real‑world challenges effectively, efficiently and creatively.
  • Act as a quality keeper by documenting code, processes, architectural decisions, increasing code coverage continuously.

Please submit your resume/CV in English

What We Are Looking For

  • 8+ years of experience coding with C#, Angular, or similar.
  • Experience with API development.
  • Solid understanding of database concepts and SQL.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and integration with test automation.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS) and GitHub.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies.
  • Excellent problem‑solving and analytical skills.
  • Actively integrate AI tools and techniques to accelerate development cycles and improve software quality.
  • At least Upper‑Intermediate level of spoken and written English.

Bonus Points

  • Cloud Certifications, preferably AWS
  • Familiarity with GitHub and GitHub Actions
  • Previous experience working with geospatial data.

How We Work

At Fugro, we believe in alignment, autonomy, and personal accountability throughout the product life cycle. Our collaborative work environment blends the flexibility of remote work with in‑office collaboration, fostering a culture built on trust.

About Fugro

Fugro is the world’s leading independent provider of geo‑intelligence and asset integrity solutions for large construction, infrastructure, and natural resources. We collect and analyze data about the Earth and the structures built upon it, providing comprehensive information and advice to our clients to help them make better decisions about their assets and projects. We rely on innovation to push the transition towards net‑zero carbon, safe infrastructure and climate resilience to deliver on our promise to create a safe and livable world.

Why would you join us?

International Geo‑data environment – We work for and with the entire world. The Earth is fascinating, as are the people on it. We work hard to create and maintain an inclusive culture. Challenging projects and exciting opportunities – We are ahead of the curve and have the best projects to work on. In addition, exciting opportunities arise around the world every day. Freedom to grow faster – If you are prepared to take the initiative, ample opportunities locally or worldwide await you at Fugro.

title: Billing Coordinator
description:
About Us


Airswift is the leading workforce solutions provider to the STEM industries. For over 40 years Airswift has been transforming lives through the provision of international workforce solutions to STEM industries. Today, we are an integrated team of over 900 employees across 37 countries, supporting over 8,000 contractors globally.


We are a people business – we transform lives through the world of work. We care about wellbeing, community engagement and our planet – we plant a tree for every person placed in a job globally! We have a passion for growth, including investing in the development of our people.


We support professionals looking for jobs with exceptional firms in the technology, construction, and engineering sectors.



Role Description


The Billing Coordinator will lead our Billing Team in delivering exceptional invoicing experiences to our valued clients in the Americas Region. In this role, you will supervise, develop, motivate, and mentor the Billing Team to ensure that all invoicing is carried out punctually, comprehensively, and with precision. Collaboration with various functions within Airswift, including Operations, Accounting, and Accounts Receivables, is crucial. The Billing Coordinator will manage a high volume of invoicing, resolve escalated issues, and cultivate an environment that places significant emphasis on customer service and efficiency. Adaptability and quick learning are key attributes for success in this role.



Principle Accountabilities



  • Streamline and oversee the billing process across multiple contract types.

  • Responsible for implementing and documenting regional policies and procedures while ensuring adherence to applicable group policies and procedures.

  • Provide hands-on training and collaborate with operations to identify and implement process improvements.

  • Plan and execute quality assurance initiatives for all processes.

  • Ensure that team productivity, compliance, and quality standards are consistently met.

  • Identify problems, propose alternatives, recommend solutions, and implement approved solutions.

  • Collaborate with the collections team to research and resolve billing issues or discrepancies, working closely with the sales and operations departments to ensure accuracy and contract compliance of disputed items.



Skills, Knowledge, and Experience



  • Bachelor's degree (BA or BS) in Accounting or Finance, or an equivalent level of knowledge in a relevant field.

  • Fluent English.

  • Mandatory minimum of 8 years of experience in progressive accounts receivable/billing roles, preferably in the staffing industry.

  • Mandatory minimum of 5 years of people management experience, including direct employees and via Leads/Supervisors.

  • Brazilian billing process (local taxes) strong knowledge is required.

  • Preferred experience with third-party payer guidelines, billing practices, and reimbursement practices.

  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to effectively manage and mentor staff.

  • Capability to work independently and within a team environment.

  • Strong organizational, time management, and interpersonal skills.

  • Analytical skills to evaluate situations, present conclusions, and recommend action plans.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; fluency in English is required.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications such as Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.



What we can offer you!



  • Attractive monthly base salary + competitive commission/performance bonus.

  • Genuine career progression opportunities, either locally or globally!

  • World-class training programmes and development opportunities.

  • Virtual Onboarding Events exclusively for new hires.

  • Team driven environment, supportive culture with a focus on work-life balance.

  • Career breaks available after one year.

  • Real time recognition through our employee reward platform.

  • Mental Health First Aiders to signpost you to support when you need it.

  • Yearly destination trips as part of our High Flyers program (Dubai, Buenos Aires, etc…)

  • Charity days for various important causes such as Relay for Life and Earth Day.



Our Core Values



  • Growth - In life and business, one must grow to flourish and achieve high ambitions. Growth requires change, challenge, risk and sacrifice - we will always choose growth.

  • Life – Above all else, we value life. The quality of life, both in and outside of work, profoundly influences our well-being and our impact on the world.

  • Excellence - We deliver, holding ourselves accountable for results. Our customers see excellence in everything we do.

  • Integrity - We are ethical, open, honest and authentic. People trust us to do the right thing for the right reason.

title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit.

Carta’s fund administration platform supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, representing $150B in assets under administration in venture capital and private equity. Trusted by more than 50,000 companies, Carta also helps private businesses in over 160 countries manage their cap tables, valuations, taxes, equity programs, compensation, and more.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. Most of Carta's long-term success will come from products and technology that have yet to be built. Here is an incomplete list of how you might contribute:

  • Building customer-facing enterprise tools for equity administration
  • Creating data pipelines for asynchronously aggregating financial reports
  • Reinforcing service resiliency, availability, and fault tolerance
  • Streamlining the creation of new features and services within our ecosystem
  • Integrating with third-party vendors to provide reliable, accurate, and timely transfers of billions of dollars per year through Carta's platform
  • Refactoring existing features into standalone event-driven services
  • And others for you to discover and champion

You'll work directly with internal and external stakeholders to ensure we're building the right thing at the right time with the right people. Your contributions will enable Carta's mission to make equity more available and accessible to everyone.

The Team You’ll Work With

This role sits on our Data Integrations team, building the necessary network infrastructure for the flow of financial and HRIS (Human Resources Information Systems) data into and out of Carta, powering the entire company management experience.

You will join our engineering team of passionate learners, builders, experts, and leaders to define and implement Carta's next generation of products, platforms, and infrastructure. You'll collaborate closely with key stakeholders in Product, Business, and Design. Carta's software engineers contribute in many different ways: sometimes we are shipping new product features, architecting simple and maintainable systems, or training the organization on new technology solutions. You will make your own mark here.

About You

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross functionally to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer.
  • You have strong technical skills and are an excellent collaborator.
  • You implement systems that are clear, maintainable, and correct.
  • You are excited by opportunities to both break ground on new projects and provide fresh perspective onto past implementations.
  • You want to build and own your work end-to-end
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.
  • You have full stack experience, specifically with Typescript, Next.js, and/or Node.js
The Interview Process

First, one of our recruiters will call you to tell you more about the job and company. You'll then meet an Engineering leader who will discuss your opportunities at Carta and explore your experience, skills, and goals. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real-world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode-style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly-linked list). Finally, you'll have back-to-back conversations with Carta team members on a wide range of topics, including communications and collaboration, coding efficacy and techniques, and systems design.

Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brasil

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

A Logística é um ponto-chave na nossa missão de encantar o(a) cliente. Afinal, para atingir o objetivo de transformar o mercado de meios de pagamento, é preciso pensar em cada detalhe.

Nossa missão é garantir o melhor e mais rápido atendimento do país. Para atingir esse objetivo, nossa área é responsável por atuar em toda cadeia logística (Supply, Sistemas, Last Mile, Gente e Segurança), colocando a mão na massa desde as compras das maquininhas até a sua efetiva entrega para nossos(as) clientes.

Como é ser um(a) Analista de Logística - Atendimento Ativo (Recuperação de Terminais) | HUNTER ANGEL:

Conhecido como Hunter Angels, esse time tem a missão de reduzir a quantidade de perdas de máquinas e aumentar a eficiência da cadeia logística, gerando rentabilidade para a companhia.

Para isso, a sua rotina é realizar atendimento ativo aos clientes por meio de telefone e, quando necessário, em múltiplos canais para recuperação dos terminais (maquininhas) que estão em clientes inativos.

As principais atividades são:

  • Atuar no atendimento ao cliente;
  • Abrir ordens de serviço para que o time de Green Angels realize a coleta de maquininhas;
  • Realizar o cancelamento do cadastro dos clientes.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Ensino superior cursando ou concluído (preferencialmente em administração, engenharias, logística ou áreas correlatas);
  • Experiência prévia com atendimento ativo ao cliente;
  • Excelente comunicação oral e escrita;
  • Foco no cumprimento de metas;
  • Capacidade de se adaptar a mudanças;
  • Disponibilidade de horário entre as 09h às 20h

O que aumenta as suas chances:

  • Conhecimento intermediário em Excel.
  • Habilidade analítica.
  • Já ter atuado com atingimento de metas.

Jornada de Trabalho:

  • CLT: 40 horas semanais com 1h de intervalo diário | Escala: 5x2 (Segunda-feira a Sexta-feira)

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico

Hospital Digital, da Vitta: contamos com uma equipe médica multidisciplinar, terapeutas e um time de saúde disponível 24 horas por dia 7 dias por semana de forma rápida e prática

30% de adicional por periculosidade em cima do salário fixo, apenas em caso de uso de motocicleta (exclusivo para vagas externas)

Benefício Educação - Plataforma interna com acesso a diversos livros, podcasts, treinamentos e videoaulas (Studa e Biblioteca StoneCo).

Obs: Vaga de Estágio não contempla remuneração variável, auxilio creche, convênio SESC, PLR e adicional de periculosidade.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!

Entrevistas com o time de People: Este é o momento de nos conhecermos! Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

Case Técnico: Você apresentará a resolução de um case técnico simulando problemas que enfrentamos hoje na operação, tanto no assunto de pessoas quanto no de resultados.

Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone

Aqui na Stone Co. valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para nos ajudar a melhorar a vida das pessoas empreendedoras do Brasil. Nosso sonho é do tamanho do universo e, se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente!

Caso queira saber mais:

As a Senior QA Automation Engineer II , you won’t just be writing tests—you’ll be a force multiplier for quality across the engineering organization. You’ll work across multiple product teams to drive a strategic shift: from QA as a safety net to quality as a shared responsibility, embedded into every part of the development lifecycle.
You’ll lead efforts to identify critical coverage gaps, implement and scale test automation frameworks, and roll out self-service tools that enable developers to write, run, and promote tests with confidence. You’ll partner closely with embedded QAs, developers, and platform teams to shift QA towards an enablement model that amplifies impact across teams.
You’ll help pilot new ways of working that reduce manual effort, catch defects earlier, and improve the signal-to-noise ratio in our CI pipeline—whether through smarter automation, better tooling, or new AI-integrated approaches to test reliability and triage. Ultimately, your work will help Carta move faster without sacrificing confidence—by making automated quality an invisible but essential part of our software delivery process.
The Team You'll Work With
The QA Organization consists of ~15 QAs who work closely with our Product, Engineering, and Support teams. We work cross-functionally across the organization to make sure we are testing our product before our clients get to use them. This is a highly visible and critical role to help define and implement QA processes within different teams, plus help with manual and automation testing to test our products thoroughly and deliver with high quality.
About You

  • Fluency in English with strong written and verbal communication skills (we communicate closely with global teams on a daily basis!)
  • 6-8+ years of experience in software engineering or automation engineering role
  • Strong programming expertise in one OOP language like Python, Java, JS or Go (Python preferred)
  • Experience building and maintaining test frameworks using tools like Selenium/Webdriver, Pytest, Cypress, Playwright
  • Deep practical understanding of test strategies (unit, integration, E2E, performance, load testing).
  • Understanding of CI/CD and hands on experience with building and deployment tools (CircleCI, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Docker) and test analytics (e.g., Datadog, Sentry)
  • Strong experience with automation and software design patterns, with proven experience in both backend and frontend projects
  • Strong knowledge in cloud infrastructure and container orchestration (Kubernetes preferred)
  • You have the ability to understand the technical needs for the teams and help them implement QA processes and mindset
  • You are a self-starter who thrives on solving open-ended problems, not just executing Jira tickets
  • You identify patterns and recurring issues proactively and build scalable solutions to reduce future friction
  • You have a history of shipping test frameworks or systems used by others beyond your immediate team.
  • You have a track record of advancing quality maturity by shifting QA from hands-on execution to developer enablement through self-service tooling and process improvements
  • You are passionate about mentoring junior level team members to help them grow and learn
Please note: Please submit your resume in English. This role will be hybrid in our Rio office.

  • Identificar as melhores oportunidades de investimentos, garantindo assertividade comercial;
  • Construir e disseminar as melhores práticas de investimentos entre os assessores;
  • Realizar consultoria de investimentos para garantir excelência no atendimento e monitorar os indicadores de qualidade;
  • Atuar no nível tático e estratégico junto às áreas que impactam direta e indiretamente o cliente final.

  • Perfil comercial e relacional;

  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Latin America Infrastructure and Mobility Project Manager

RINA is currently recruiting for a Latin America Infrastructure and Mobility Project Manager to join its office in Rio de Janeiro (RJ) or São Paulo (SP) within the International Infrastructure & Mobility Division.

Mission : As an Infrastructures & Mobility Project Manager at RINA, you will play a crucial role in overseeing and leading complex projects within the Infrastructure and Mobility sectors. Your responsibilities will be integral to the successful execution of paramount projects in the LATAM region, ensuring they are delivered according to the highest quality standards and within specified timelines and budgets.

Key Accountabilities :

  • Leading and managing large-scale engineering projects in sectors such as Metro, Rail, LRT, Roads, Ports, and Wet/Dry Infrastructures.
  • Overseeing the complete project lifecycle from planning and design to execution and close-out, ensuring alignment with strategic business objectives.

  • Managing and mitigating project risks, ensuring proactive identification and resolution of potential issues.
  • Coordinating and collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to ensure seamless project delivery, overseeing contract management and compliance with regulations.
  • Monitoring and reporting on project progress, performance, and financial metrics, ensuring transparency and effective communication with senior management and stakeholders.
  • Ensuring all projects are delivered in accordance with quality standards and requirements.
  • Driving continuous improvement initiatives to enhance project delivery processes and methodologies.
  • Leading stakeholder engagement and communication strategies to maintain strong relationships with clients, regulatory bodies, and other key stakeholders.

Qualifications :

  • Hold a bachelor's degree in Engineering (Civil Engineering preferred). A Master's degree or postgraduate degree in Project Management is a plus.
  • Proven experience in Project Management and Contract Management within the Mobility (Metro, Rail, LRT) and/or Infrastructure (Roads, Ports, Wet and Dry Infrastructures) sectors.
  • Having CAT (Certidão de Acervo Técnico) is a plus.
  • Track record of successfully delivering complex engineering projects on time and within budget.
  • Extensive experience in managing multidisciplinary teams and multiple stakeholders.
  • In-depth knowledge of project management methodologies, tools, and best practices, along with a solid understanding of contract law, procurement processes, and risk management strategies.
  • Strong leadership and decision-making skills, with the ability to influence and inspire teams.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

Preferred Qualifications :

Additional Information :

Competencies :

  • PIONEER CHANGE - Actively embrace change and benefit from the new circumstances

Consultor Especialista em Processos II | Rio de Janeiro - Híbrido

Brazil - Rio de Janeiro

O profissional será responsável pela análise crítica e pela gestão de planos de ação, além de propor soluções para problemas relacionados aos projetos da Gerência Executiva.

  • Atuação na área de gestão e processos, com foco no suporte e execução de tarefas operacionais de complexidade média. Será responsável pela análise estruturada de dados e informações, consolidada de levantamentos, além de apoiar e eventualmente orientar a realização das atividades relacionadas ao desenvolvimento de soluções e implementação de melhorias na gestão da rotina e dos processos da Gerência Executiva.
  • Suporte na estruturação de documentos, relatórios e apresentações; validação, análise e proposição de conteúdos; e desenvolvimento de soluções de média complexidade no atendimento das demandas na área (subeixo) em que atua. O escopo de atividades envolve pesquisas (levantamento, estruturação e consolidação de dados), análise crítica de informações consolidadas, planejamento, estruturação e execução de relatórios e apresentações, preparação de reuniões, eventos (palestras, treinamentos, workshops, reuniões gerenciais, etc.), geração de conteúdos e desenvolvimento de soluções para as demandas de trabalho, garantindo excelência, alta qualidade, desempenho e atendimento tempestivo às demandas junto às gerências que prestarão serviço.
  • Pesquisar, estruturar e consolidar informações para a composição de documentos, relatórios e pareceres relacionados à gestão das rotinas e dos processos, promovendo a consolidação, revisão e disponibilização para a avaliação e validação final dos profissionais que atuam nas demandas de complexidade alta e gestor líder da CONTRATADA, além de gestores e especialistas da PETROBRAS.
  • Será também responsável pela estruturação do material das RACs (Reuniões de Análise Crítica) e pela gestão e controle dos indicadores de desempenho e metas das gerências, com geração de alertas, levantamento do histórico e comportamento dos indicadores e metas, realização de análise crítica e estruturação da visão prospectiva e evolutiva dos resultados ao longo do ano.   • Prestar suporte direto na estruturação e desenvolvimento das propostas de indicadores de desempenho, incluindo, mas não se limitando ao levantamento de insumos, alimentação de sistemas, análises de resultados, elaboração de materiais para validação gerencial e revisões de insumos.
  • Os processos, atividades e tarefas atreladas a este quadrante de prestação de serviços são de complexidade média e exigem conhecimento específico, capacitação e experiência. Envolvem conteúdo analítico para estruturação, gestão e controle de planos de ação no tratamento de demandas específicas na área/eixo de atuação, com vistas de garantir resultados para a respectiva gestão que atuar.
  • Deverá também controlar processos e atividades tais como: apuração de resultados de indicadores, identificação de anomalias e desvios de processos, organização de RACs gerenciais, preparação de apresentações e relatórios para apoio gerencial, controle do avanço de tarefas dos Planos de Ação e Iniciativas Estratégicas, mapeamento e desenho de fluxos de processos, entre outras atribuições correlatas.
  • Graduação: Administração, Engenharia, Contabilidade, Direito, Economia, Análise de Tecnologia da Informação, Administrador de Tecnologia da Informação ou outras áreas correlatas à especialidade.
  • Experiência de atuação nas seguintes especialidades: Gestão Empresarial, Gestão Estratégica, Gestão por Resultados, Gestão Ágil, Gestão de Processos ou outras áreas correlatas à especialidade.
  • Boa comunicação interpessoal e escrita, com habilidade para facilitar interações entre áreas diversas.
  • Proatividade na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria e entrega de soluções.
  • Domínio das ferramentas: Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word e MS Project.

What’s the role?

As a Dynatrace Solution Engineer, you will be a key member of the Dynatrace sales engine and will be responsible for providing excellent technical support to the sales team. To ensure your success as a Solution Engineer at Dynatrace, you need to be an ambitious, confident and self-motivated individual, with previous SE experience or another technical customer facing role.   • Evangelize Dynatrace’s product offerings during international trade shows and at key customer account meetings to promote new and expanded business.

  • Present Dynatrace’s vision to our customers C-suite executives.
  • Provide technical guidance in the Discovery, Solution Evaluation, and Solution Proposal stages of the opportunity sales cycle.
  • Present on-stage demonstrations providing insight and context to our customers during key marketing events.

  • Experience with programming / scripting side technologies such as Java, .NET, PHP, Go, Node.js and database.
  • Advance knowledge of Operating Systems (OS) including Windows and Linux.

  • Experience with modern technologies like containers, Kubernetes / OpenShift, Serverless functions, and CI/CD pipelines.

Why you will love being a Dynatracer

  • Over 50% of the Fortune 100 companies are current customers of Dynatrace.

Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. Our mission is to reinvent the way companies manage their open source information systems - on public clouds and in their own data centers. To achieve that we are building a new community around Python opscode for open source applications, running on Kubernetes. We want to move all of Canonical and Ubuntu IS onto this new open source codebase. We are confident that we can dramatically improve the experience of running complex business operations - and then we can help our customers embrace those new techniques and products. Traditionally, IS is an inward-facing operation. We would like to transform our IS team into an extension of the product engineering capability at Canonical. Our internal workloads are in many cases the same open source workloads that our customers want to operate. This team will productize those workloads for real-time automated operations on Kubernetes. This role is ideal for software engineers who enjoy Python, have a passion for distributed systems, and an interest in the entire Linux stack - from kernel to networking to virtualization and containers. It is a role that requires rigor in both code and customer interactions. Our engineers are technically astute open source enthusiasts who are excited about cloud computing and are ready to join a global team charged with delivering world class services to our customers.

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You are experienced with Linux systems administration, package management, and operations
  • You have hands-on experience with at least one public cloud
  • You are familiar with Docker and Kubernetes
  • You are an experienced Python programmer and enjoy challenging projects
  • You understand the importance of reliable software and strive to design and code to that expectation
  • You are organized and want your team to deliver timely, high quality software

What we offer colleagues

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
